title: Shedeur Sanders throws for 79 yards, an interception vs. Bears

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders throws for 79 yards, an interception vs. Bears
sources.description: After quarterback Deshaun Watson had a so-so first half against the Bears, throwing for 126 yards, Shedeur Sanders also had a middling performance in the second half of the Browns’ first preseason game.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deshaun Watson throws for 126 yards in 2026 preseason debut
sources.description: In competition with Shedeur Sanders, Deshaun Watson started the first preseason game for the Browns on Saturday against the Bears and played the entire first half.
